replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA transforms correlated data into uncorrelated axes by: 1) Centering your dataset. 2) Computing covariance matrices to find eigenvectors (principal components). 3) Sorting eigenvalues to retain variance. Don’t panic! The math is linear algebra—focus on intuition: PCA reduces dimensionality without losing critical patterns. Start with 2D plots for sanity checks.
